versions.subject: Merge PR from @swachchhanda000 - SolarWinds WebHelpDesk RCE Vulnerabilites Exploitation
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|contains: '\WebHelpDesk\bin\'
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\java.exe'
        - '\javaw.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: 'tomcat'
selection_suspicious_child:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-enc'
        - 'base64'
        - 'bitsadmin'
        - 'certutil'
        - 'curl'
        - 'Invoke-RestMethod'
        - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
        - 'irm '
        - 'iwr '
        - 'mshta'
        - 'msiexec'
        - 'Net.WebClient'
        - 'Start-BitsTransfer'
        - 'wget'
        - 'wmic'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\WebHelpDesk\\bin\\*" ParentImage IN ("*\\java.exe", "*\\javaw.exe") ParentCommandLine="*tomcat*" CommandLine IN ("*-enc*", "*base64*", "*bitsadmin*", "*certutil*", "*curl*", "*Invoke-RestMethod*", "*Invoke-WebRequest*", "*irm *", "*iwr *", "*mshta*", "*msiexec*", "*Net.WebClient*", "*Start-BitsTransfer*", "*wget*", "*wmic*")
